name: snap-feel
description: Placing a chest: Q / E cycle the 14 snap points and the chest locks flush against another chest

steps.message: Build a wood chest, then pick another wood chest in the build menu. Press Q / E: does the message in the middle show 'Snapping: Bottom Front Left' and so on, cycling through 14 points?
Aim the held chest at the placed one with a corner point selected: does it lock flush, face to face, without a gap or overlap?
Open the console (F5), run chestsnap_show on: are yellow and cyan spheres on the corners and face centers? Then chestsnap_show off.
